verdict.rationale: PayPal documents an official MCP server that lets merchants use natural language from their MCP clients, and a runtime probe confirms a live remote endpoint at mcp.paypal.com/mcp with OAuth protected-resource metadata. The Agent Toolkit, published on npm, also explicitly supports MCP. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a full authenticated client connection and tool invocation, and detailed client setup steps in the evidence.
